tools.name: outlook_get_free_busy
tools.description: Query free/busy availability for one or more technician calendars over a date/time range via the Microsoft Graph calendarView API. Read-only. This is the authoritative real-time check that supersedes the staged roster's available_dates field if the two disagree.

tools.name: outlook_get_resource_calendar_events
tools.description: Retrieve existing events on the shared maintenance resource calendar (e.g., 'Plant A - Maintenance Schedule') for a date range, for conflict/double-booking detection before publishing new events. Read-only.

tools.name: outlook_create_event
tools.description: Create a preventive maintenance event on the shared maintenance resource calendar, with the equipment as location and assigned technician(s) as required attendees. Callers must run outlook_get_free_busy for every attendee immediately before calling this tool — the server does not perform its own conflict check, so a caller that skips the free/busy read risks a double-booking. On a detected conflict, do not call this tool for the conflicting slot; request up to 3 alternative slots from the scheduling engine and retry before escalating to a human planner.

tools.name: outlook_update_event
tools.description: Update the start/end time, attendees, or subject of an existing preventive maintenance event, used during incremental re-optimization. Re-run outlook_get_free_busy for the new time before calling this tool.

tools.name: outlook_cancel_event
tools.description: Cancel/delete an existing preventive maintenance event on the shared resource calendar, e.g., when a disruption removes the need for a previously scheduled task.
